classifications.rationale: The President mandates that the Secretary of Commerce later use export-control administration to terminate covered shipments while allowing licenses up to a specified limit; the legal consequences occur through subsequent agency controls and licensing.
classifications.evidence: take immediate action under the Export Administration Act to terminate shipments of agricultural commodities and products

classifications.rationale: The President presently makes the statutory determination supporting export controls, so the legally consequential determination occurs in this segment itself.
classifications.evidence: I have determined in accordance with the Export Administration Act that the absence of controls would be detrimental to those interests

classifications.rationale: The President mandates that the Secretary of Agriculture later undertake commodity purchases and use price-support and grain-reserve programs, producing the specified consequences through subsequent agency administration.
classifications.evidence: take the necessary actions, through commodity purchases, and through the price support and grain reserve programs
